def solve(n: int, L: int) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)
    oracle = GroverOracle(n, L, invert_target=False)

    # Initialize all qubits to |1>
    qc.xall()

    # Apply Hadamard gates
